prose_overlay.tldr: Heterogeneous sites may supply observational, interventional, and genuine Layer-3 partial-copy laws.  Certified extraction yields local district rows, while exact graph-compatible canonical fibers retain every cross-district complete-menu equation on the original observed alphabets.  The hybrid procedure returns an allowed rational functional when the local recursion identifies the query and otherwise gives an exact real-semialgebraic range or an evidence-status rejection.  Global regime-block acquisition may itself establish conditional definability: only the full acquired fiber must be uniformly positive, every candidate subset is screened exactly, and exhaustive search returns all least-cost subsets preserving the full-menu arm set.  The local LP remains the cheaper special case with a checked positive evidence bound on its base face, and the Boolean pushforward witness shows that neither local nor global arm elimination is submodular in general.
prose_overlay.related_work: Correa, Lee, and Bareinboim (2022, Theorem 5.1) provide source-labelled conditional transport for Layer-1 and Layer-2 inputs; only the declared observational and hard-interventional intersection is embedded here.  Raghavan and Bareinboim (2026, Theorem 3.5 and Appendix E.1) provide Layer-3 factor extraction and ctf-thickets for one causal specification; their positive published class is not silently replaced.  Zhang, Tian, and Bareinboim (2022, Theorem 2.4) provide the finite canonical reduction adapted here domain by domain, while Choe et al. (2026, Proposition 3.1) motivate information-preserving rows.  Bareinboim and Pearl (2012, Theorems 5--7; 2014) concern vertex-level selection diagrams and multi-environment transport, not district response-block Layer-3 acquisition.  Park and Lee (2026, ICLR, Theorems 1--3) motivate realizable Layer-3 arms, and Park and Lee (2026, UAI, Theorems 1--2) provide Layer-1 and Layer-2 transported bandit bounds; neither supplies the subset-screened exact canonical design that can acquire evidence definability.
prose_overlay.interpretation: A purchased regime block has two logically separate effects.  It can remove canonical models on which evidence vanishes, thereby making the conditional query uniformly defined, and it can remove models on which a competing arm is optimal.  Because augmented fibers are nested, both positivity and arm elimination are monotone with acquisition, so the feasible design family is upward closed.  Complementary experiments can nevertheless have increasing marginal pruning gains, which rules out a general submodular shortcut.
prose_overlay.technical_internal_limitation: The local active row space remains boundary sensitive and is exact only with focal-district saturation plus baseline-averaged separation or a stronger stated certificate; otherwise it is an outer relaxation of the exact sparse canonical program.  The global Route-B fallback preserves every complete output cell, deterministic pushforward, graph-compatible latent restriction, and arbitrary real canonical parameter, but quantifier elimination returns formulas and decisions rather than explicit endpoint numbers, canonical samples, or paired SCM objects.  Exhaustive acquisition is exponential in \(|\mathcal U|\), and non-submodularity prevents a general greedy guarantee.
prose_overlay.honest_scope: The exact global results hold for finite recursive SCMs on the declared original alphabets and effectively rational or real-algebraic supplied cell probabilities, with quantifier-free syntax interpreted over \(\mathbb R\).  Non-singleton ranges guarantee two same-menu original-alphabet SCMs existentially; the algorithm is not claimed to extract them.  Global acquisition defines numerical arm rankings only on subsets satisfying \(\operatorname{Pos}_G(S)\), although a base menu may have mixed evidence; the full acquired fiber must be positive.  The local LP is unchanged and assumes a checked base-face evidence bound.  The Boolean postprocessors disclose complete output laws, not unsupplied joint tuple cells.  No published CTFTR, CTFIDU+, selection-diagram, or bandit completeness theorem is claimed to cover this district-closed heterogeneous Layer-3 class.

project_justification.gap: CTFTR treats heterogeneous Layer-1 and Layer-2 transport, CTFIDU+ treats positive one-specification Layer-3 identification, and transported bandit work does not give an exact finite sparse-ADMG acquisition objective whose purchased menu may establish conditional definability.
project_justification.niche: District-closed response-block invariance supports a fast local row calculus, while the exact canonical fallback retains all complete cross-menu polynomial information.  Subset-specific positivity separates the causal question of whether a conditional is defined from the numerical question of which arms remain optimal.
project_justification.fill: The project proves exact saturated and sparse-canonical fixed-alphabet range characterizations, a terminating sound rational fast path with zero-denominator rejection, sharp conditional bounds and pruning certificates, a checked-positive local LP acquisition layer, and an exact global acquisition layer that screens every augmented fiber and permits the full menu to create uniform definability.

thm:exact-global-canonical-frontier.justification: The theorem separates exact all-district saturated variation, exact sparse canonical optimization, and exact single-baseline focal-district geometry.
thm:exact-global-canonical-frontier.gap: Global programs retain every cross-district polynomial equality; locally, baseline-averaged separation is weaker than pointwise active-slice control but still needs focal saturation.
thm:exact-global-canonical-frontier.consumer: Sharp bounds, positivity screens, subset-specific conditional rankings, and paired-model existence all use the appropriate exact global range equality.

lem:district-cell-linearity.justification: The lemma distinguishes raw output cells from conditional extractions, proving the latter as ratios of separately constructed numerator and context rows.
lem:district-cell-linearity.gap: Existing Layer-3 factorization does not supply this source-labelled postprocessing-aware, exhaustive-locality row interface.
lem:district-cell-linearity.consumer: DCTFTR, face identification, and all checked-arm programs use only the separately proved equalities.

thm:one-district-fiber-projection.justification: One fixed compatible baseline suffices to lift every focal row-face law while preserving all complete menu cells.
thm:one-district-fiber-projection.gap: Cross-district cells can obstruct projection unless their baseline-averaged focal rows annihilate every face difference.
thm:one-district-fiber-projection.consumer: Local identification, dominance, and boundary witnesses use this exact lift.

thm:face-aware-identification.justification: Forced-zero coordinates give a broad sufficient identifying functional and an exact focal-class converse after locality accepts.
thm:face-aware-identification.gap: A null direction in a broad row relaxation is not automatically a sparse-ADMG countermodel.
thm:face-aware-identification.consumer: The face test returns either an affine menu functional or, in its exact scope, two original-alphabet SCMs.

lem:dctftr-transition-preservation.justification: Every rule preserves denotation using constructive extraction rows and original-district splitting.
lem:dctftr-transition-preservation.gap: Induced-subgraph district factorization and quotient-as-row shortcuts were not justified.
lem:dctftr-transition-preservation.consumer: Trace checking reduces terminal soundness to local verified identities.

thm:recursion-soundness.justification: The transition invariant proves a finite, deterministic, zero-safe rational fast path on the broad fiber.
thm:recursion-soundness.gap: Neither comparator calculus covers heterogeneous source labels and genuine Layer-3 menus together.
thm:recursion-soundness.consumer: Successful formulas are directly evaluable from released menu cells.

prop:typed-instance-embeddings.justification: The embeddings cover only explicit grammar intersections and use identity postprocessors on legacy descriptors.
prop:typed-instance-embeddings.gap: Full policy syntax and undeclared Layer-2.5 actions are outside the proved maps.
prop:typed-instance-embeddings.consumer: Users can separate inherited cases from genuinely new heterogeneous Layer-3 inputs.

thm:transported-dominance-duality.justification: A total checked-local-arms record supplies every arm row and one exact uniform evidence lower bound before the LP dual is formed.
thm:transported-dominance-duality.gap: Transported bandit results do not give this heterogeneous Layer-3 source-menu dual or the focal original-alphabet optimizer lift.
thm:transported-dominance-duality.consumer: Positive dual value safely removes an arm, while exact focal projection realizes reversing optimizers when available.

thm:one-cell-sign-regime-frontier.justification: The parametric LP gives the exact convex piecewise-affine sign frontier and dual boundary certificates.
thm:one-cell-sign-regime-frontier.gap: Existing fixed-menu results do not expose a source Layer-3 cell value as a pruning phase parameter.
thm:one-cell-sign-regime-frontier.consumer: Study design can locate sign boundaries and determine when the boundary row law is a causal SCM.

prop:binary-acquisition-check.justification: The complete binary calculation verifies the dual margin and singleton postprocessed Layer-3 cell on original alphabets.
prop:binary-acquisition-check.gap: The witness is a legal complete output cell, not an arbitrary Boolean event row.
prop:binary-acquisition-check.consumer: It is a regression test for row extraction, sign certification, and arm elimination.

prop:certified-arm-removal.justification: Explicit locality and common-evidence positivity make the elementary removal rule fully typed.
prop:certified-arm-removal.gap: Without positivity a numerator order does not rank conditional values.
prop:certified-arm-removal.consumer: Bandit initialization can prune safely while treating zero evidence as undefined.

thm:finite-layer3-acquisition-obstructio.justification: The explicit Boolean-pushforward bow instance proves that complete Layer-3 regime blocks can be complementary rather than diminishing-return substitutes.
thm:finite-layer3-acquisition-obstructio.gap: No generic submodular guarantee follows from response-face nesting, even with sure evidence and two unit-cost experiments.
thm:finite-layer3-acquisition-obstructio.consumer: The witness justifies exact enumeration or integer optimization for both the checked-positive local layer and its exact global realization.

thm:hybrid-fixed-alphabet-completeness.justification: This is the fixed-declared-alphabet completion: every unresolved local trace is followed by an exact real-semialgebraic range or an evidence-status decision.
thm:hybrid-fixed-alphabet-completeness.gap: Published transport and one-domain Layer-3 algorithms do not provide this source-labelled rational-fast-path plus exact sparse-canonical fallback on the original alphabets.
thm:hybrid-fixed-alphabet-completeness.consumer: A user receives an allowed rational functional or exact range and endpoint formulas, with division rejected unless evidence is uniformly positive; explicit optimizer extraction is not promised.

lem:active-slice-implies-baseline-averag.justification: The hierarchy isolates the weakest single-baseline condition actually used by the lift.
lem:active-slice-implies-baseline-averag.gap: Pointwise slice membership can fail even when its fixed-law average is active.
lem:active-slice-implies-baseline-averag.consumer: Downstream exact local clauses use baseline-averaged separation.

lem:structural-separation-implies-active.justification: The proof covers deterministic-preimage output cells as ordinary finite indicators.
lem:structural-separation-implies-active.gap: Structural separation is easier to check but stronger than slice separation.
lem:structural-separation-implies-active.consumer: It supplies a baseline-free sufficient route to exact focal projection.

thm:global-canonical-acquisition-complet.justification: This theorem makes sparse-ADMG acquisition exact on every positive augmented broad-model fiber and allows the acquired full menu itself to establish conditional definability.
thm:global-canonical-acquisition-complet.gap: Existing transported-bandit and Layer-3 identification results do not give subset-specific evidence screening inside an exact heterogeneous canonical acquisition objective.
thm:global-canonical-acquisition-complet.consumer: A user can buy the least-cost complete regime blocks that both make evidence uniformly positive and preserve the full-menu possibly-optimal arm set.

sampling_model.design: Exact population laws are supplied for finite source-labelled observational, interventional, and declared partial-copy descriptors. Descriptor \(a\) reports the complete finite law of \(f_a(T_a)\); the full tuple law of \(T_a\) is not supplied unless an identity-output tuple descriptor is separately present.
sampling_model.units: Each supplied law is induced by independent units from its domain-specific finite recursive SCM. District exogenous response blocks are independent within a domain, and unchanged districts share their entire response-block law with the target domain.
sampling_model.treatment: Interventions and partial-copy terms are fixed by each descriptor, deterministic output maps are declared, and the selection set \(\Delta_s\) may change only whole bidirected districts.
sampling_model.overlap: No blanket positivity assumption is imposed.  The identification procedure rejects uniform zero or nonuniform evidence before division.  Local arm acquisition assumes a checked positive lower bound on the base row face; global acquisition instead requires uniform positivity only on the full acquired canonical fiber and screens each candidate subset exactly before defining its numerical conditional ranking.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The results concern exact population laws and finite algebraic or linear programs. No nuisance estimator is part of the identification claim; plug-in estimation and statistical uncertainty for returned rational functionals, QE-defined ranges, or LP margins are downstream.
